findings.problem: On the phone, the line 'y → 0 + 1 = 1 ⇒ asymptote y = 1' runs into the sketch column. As it is written, the dashed asymptote and its 'y = 1' label cross over the words 'asymptote y = 1', right while the voice says them.
findings.fix: Keep line 4 inside the working column: put '⇒ asymptote y = 1' on its own line under 'y → 0 + 1 = 1', or shorten it, so no part of the sketch crosses it.

findings.problem: Once the board has scrolled, the corner-shapes box covers the end of the 'asymptote y = 1' line, so the student sees part of an equation hidden behind the inset.
findings.fix: With line 4 split or shortened so it stays left of the inset, check the beat 19–22 phone frames again: no board line may run under the corner box.
